user.description: Create a **Push** monitor in Uptime Kuma and paste its push URL. Set the monitor's heartbeat interval in Uptime Kuma to at least the push interval below.

data_description.push_url: For example {example_url}. Any query string is ignored.

cloudflare_access.name: Cloudflare Access
cloudflare_access.description: Only needed if Uptime Kuma is behind Cloudflare Access. Create a service token and add it to a **Service Auth** policy on the Access application. Leave empty otherwise.

data_description.access_client_id: Service token Client ID, ending in `.access`.

reauth_confirm.title: Cloudflare Access denied the push
reauth_confirm.description: Pushes to {host} were denied. Enter a Cloudflare Access service token that a **Service Auth** policy allows, or leave both fields empty to push without one.

data_description.access_client_id: Service token Client ID, ending in `.access`.

reconfigure.title: Cloudflare Access
